scene_objective: In the setup phase, this reveal scene establishes the anomalous ruins as the first thin place encounter, forces Ben's first withholding from Luke via the Force impression omission, and plants the lie that fractures his transparency, locking in the personal stakes against the official record.

turning_point.trigger: Ben's fingers brush a cut into the stone and the wrongness jolts up through his arm — a low vibration without physical source, registering as fractional error in distance and perception.
turning_point.shift: Ben stands, catalogs the visual markings with his datapad, and transmits the survey report with the Force impression deliberately omitted. The external action is professional; the internal choice is a fracture.
turning_point.cost: Ben's trust in his own perception is now at odds with the official record he is bound to file. Interpersonally, this is his first moment of withholding from Luke — a breach of the transparency that has defined their relationship. The cost is the beginning of isolation.

closing_beat: Ben recorded the markings and sent the data to Luke — but held back his Force impression, his first withholding.

emotional_arc.start: Professional curiosity — the archaeologist's clean focus on cataloging and solving.
emotional_arc.shift: Growing unease — the Force-sense contradicts the official record, and Ben's body registers the wrongness before his mind can frame it.
emotional_arc.end: Quiet alarm — the decision to withhold has been made and transmitted. Ben is now braced for consequences he cannot yet name.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben and Desh hike across rocky, arid terrain toward half-buried ruins. The landscape shows signs of low-frequency civilian traffic — a distant freighter contrail, perhaps a discarded supply crate — grounding the world as inhabited but not densely so.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract mission becomes concrete geography. Ben moves from briefing-room certainty into the physical reality of a world that does not match its official record.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's professional curiosity drives him forward; his body is already reading the terrain for anomalies before his conscious mind articulates the question. Instinct pushes toward action and observation rather than explanation.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben crouches to examine carved markings cut into exposed stone. The tool-marks are precise but do not match any tradition in his training. He reaches out, and his fingers brush the surface.
key_beats.state_change: The mission advances from observation to direct contact. Ben crosses from external survey into Force-active engagement with the site.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The moment his skin touches the stone, the wrongness arrives — not as a visual impression but as a low vibration that has no physical source. The sensation travels up his arm as a fractional error in distance, in the relationship between his hand and the stone, in the way the Force itself feels at this location. His body recoils before his mind catches up. Growing unease tightens his focus; he is no longer cataloging. He is bracing.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben pulls his hand back from the stone, processing the jolt. He stands, breathing controlled, and deliberately turns to his datapad. He scans the markings, records the shapes, the tool-marks, the age-estimate based on erosion. He does not record what his Force-sense just told him.
key_beats.state_change: The scene pivots from discovery to decision. Ben has gathered the data; now he chooses what to transmit and what to keep. The official record will contain the markings. It will not contain the wrongness.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Quiet alarm settles into his chest as he works. The decision is already made — he knows what he will leave out before he consciously frames it. His hands move with professional precision, but the omission is deliberate. He is not theorizing why. He is simply doing it.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben transmits the survey report to Luke. The data includes the markings, the estimated age, the geological context. The Force impression — the low vibration, the fractional error, the wrongness — does not appear in the transmission.
key_beats.state_change: The withholding is complete and irreversible. Ben has filed a report that is technically accurate but structurally incomplete. The official record now contains a gap that only he knows about.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The transmission sends. Ben is braced for the moment when Luke reads it, when his father might ask the question Ben is not prepared to answer truthfully. The quiet alarm hardens into something closer to dread — not fear of discovery, but fear of what the withholding means about his own judgment. He has chosen to trust his Force-sense over the official record, and then chosen to hide that choice from the one person he has never hidden from before.

voice_guidance: Channel Zahn's efficient dialogue and precision in archaeological observation — Ben catalogs before he hypothesizes, every line moves plot or reveals character. Allston-rhythm in Desh's banter masking growing concern, with humor-under-stress levity. Zahn-style tight third-person interiority — sharp, self-deprecating, never melodramatic. Lived-galaxy texture: freighter contrails, supply crates signal flown-through sectors. Force sensory only: tactile/vibrational low vibration without physical source, no visual/color terms, no diagnostic analysis.
anti_patterns: do not describe the wrongness in color or visual terms; keep it tactile/vibrational and use one consistent metaphor for the scene (the low vibration without a physical source)

Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, theorize why he is withholding. The withholding is behavioural; let the omission in the transmission carry it, not an interior paragraph explaining it.
Do not open with a flashback to the briefing or the survey assignment — begin in medias res with Ben and Desh already on approach or at the site.
Do not use clinical or analytical language to describe the Force impression — keep it sensory and immediate.
